# Disperse

`runtime.hex`: the runtime bytecode of Disperse (disperse.app) at
`0xD152f549545093347A162Dce210e7293f1452150`, read from Gnosis Chain on
2026-11-11 (byte-identical on Ethereum; keccak256
`0x65660051e320731a70b9ddcd5ec9fd4f565cf85e2f6caf0eb71589fb544b9996`, the
hash the disburse page checks before paying through it). The mock node serves
it at that address, and executes `disperseTokenSimple` itself.
